name: Scarlet Indian paintbrush
desc: Scarlet Indian paintbrush (Castilleja coccinea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 32 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Castilleja coccinea, commonly known as scarlet paintbrush or scarlet painted-cup, is a biennial flowering plant in the Orobanchaceae (broomrape) family.
